core_question: How do I stop a car's brakes from squealing when I press the pedal? (secondary: How do I sharpen a dull kitchen knife at home?)
answer_summary: Remove the wheel and caliper, take out the worn/thin brake pads (often down to the wear indicator causing the squeal), and install new pads, lubricating the caliper slides as needed.; after the topic shift: Hold the blade at a consistent angle and draw it across a whetstone from heel to tip on both sides repeatedly, then finish by honing on a honing steel.
